name: משוואה לינארית עם שברים – (3−v)/5 + 3 = (2v+1)/10 (באנגלית)
generalfeedback:
The objective is to get the equation into the form \({{CT:3}} = p\) where \(p\) is a rational number. When fractions are involved it is often best to multiply both sides of the equation by a certain value so that the fractions are removed. In this example:
\[ {{CT:1}} = {{CT:2}}.\]
Multiply through by \(10\):
\[ {{CT:4}} = {{CT:5}}. \]
Remove Brackets:
\[ {{CT:6}} = {{CT:5}}. \]
Gather like terms \({{CT:7}}\):
\[ {{CT:8}} = {{CT:9}}. \]
Finally divide by coefficient of \({{CT:3}}\) (\(4\)):
\[ {{CT:3}} = {{CT:10}}. \]
